description: Defines a C# interface for a test durable grain in Orleans, specifying methods for getting and setting values and retrieving activation ID.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the activation ID of the grain.

methods.name: SetValues
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the name and counter values in the grain.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the name and counter values from the grain.
